title: Incident after-action minimap and runbook extracts
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact, persistent "minimap" element for the Redwood Console incident timeline that surfaces the live incident state, top actions, and inline runbook extracts. The minimap should let an on-call commander quickly see unresolved items, jump to the related timeline range, and copy curated runbook snippets into an ad-hoc postmortem draft. Goals: reduce cognitive load during handoffs, shorten time to action during incidents, and speed post-incident documentation by surfacing relevant runbook content and past remediation steps. This ticket covers UX exploration, low-fidelity and clickable prototypes in Figma, engineering handoff notes, and a small usability test with SRE/Support participants.
acceptance_criteria: Minimap component mockups (collapsed + expanded) exist in Figma and show: current incident state, 3 highest-priority actions, and ability to jump to timeline range
Runbook extract panel design that enables selecting a snippet, copying to clipboard, or inserting into a new postmortem draft
Commander view flows (handoff + quick action) documented with microcopy for escalations and ownership transfer
Accessibility review notes: color contrast, focus order, keyboard shortcuts for jumping between minimap and timeline
Engineering-ready spec: spacing tokens, component states, responsive behavior, and a short interaction spec for animations and shortcuts

2026-03-09 - Design review: Addressed accessibility (contrast and focus outline), added microcopy for action confirmation and undo. Created engineering tickets for animation edge-cases and copy behavior.
